# Will's X bookmarks (23) and the Chabahar tanker check, 2026-11-23

**Guard:** IRAN_WAR_GUARDS.md read whole earlier today. anchor_unverified_as_of: 2026-11-18. ukmto.org, centcom.mil and MARAD returned 403 from this box; not bypassed.

| # | Item | Basis | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Citi RWA error:** understated by $35B at Citigroup Global Markets Ltd (UK), more than 20% of that unit's $155B RWA at end-2025 and about 2.7% of group; forced a capital injection (amount not given). Citi: resolved 'this summer', unit 'fully compliant with regulatory minimums throughout'. Fed declined comment. Not stated whether reported figures include it | Reuters analysis 11/23 via Yahoo, read by helper; 2.7% is a search summary; first report Thu 11/19 | GIBBS |
| 2 | **ING data-center loans:** about $500M auction closed without enough bids; moving to individual sales; includes a $25M Stargate New Mexico stake and debt tied to Vantage, CyrusOne | Bloomberg 11/20 via syndication, search summary. 'Fail' in the post is stronger than 'stalls on low bids' | VULCAN, BROCK, HANS |
| 3 | **Oracle, 11/20 after the close:** 'secured all the funding we need to fulfill our contract with OpenAI'; calls contrary media reports 'incorrect and wrong'. Issuer statement, its own claim; the report it answers was not found. ORCL $113.07 (+11.75%) vendor intraday on a market-wide rebound | Oracle post, full text; oracle.com page not opened | VULCAN |
| 4 | California's Nvidia probe also looks at potential criminal violations of state law | Bloomberg post 11/21, article not read; probe itself on 20261120-006 | VULCAN, ZHAO |
| 5 | Goldman's SpaceX pitch and AI-chip debt | Bloomberg post, article not read | VULCAN, BROCK |
| 6 | **9-day bill:** $15B sold 11/19, 3.910% high discount rate, cover 3.97, settles 11/24, matures 12/3; first 9-day since 2008. Treasury flagged it at the 11/4 refunding; bridges month-end. A $25B 10-day bill sold in October: 'cash gap' alarm is overstated | search summaries; fiscaldata returned no rows | BOND, LIQUID |
| 7 | **DNI Clayton (CNN 11/22):** expect 'glitches, gaps, interruptions'; says recent outages were upgrades, NOT coordinated or state-sponsored. Delta Atlanta fault, over 1,000 late. Cloudflare CEO: two years of outages (Kalshi post, unread). FBI crime-database hack: 20261121-003 item 6 | search summary; posts | CYPHER |
| 8 | **Alabama blast, 11:27 pm CT 11/21: Southern Natural Gas** segment, shut and depressurized, no injuries, deliveries not impacted. The Colonial suggestion in the post is NOT supported; SNG owns the event | SNG statement via WTOK, read by helper | BRENT, WATT |
| 9 | **Chabahar tanker, 11/22:** UKMTO reported 'an incident involving a tanker and military forces' (Reuters via Arab News); 1425 GMT per a search summary. The US-strike claim traces to ONE maritime analyst's X post; Gulf News: 'no official confirmation from either the US or Iran'. No vessel named. Windward names TOUR 2 nearby, not linked | pages read by helper | FALCON: **UNCONFIRMED** |
| 10 | **KHAT SHEKAN** (Iranian-flag tanker, draught 22.5 m, course 69 degrees, listed destination Nigeria): on AIS in the Strait 11/21. Only position is shown; cargo, blockade intent and any link to item 9 are the posters' inference | MarineTraffic screenshot, viewed; one origin repeated | FALCON |
| 11 | IRGC Navy says two tankers 'exploded' on sea mines north of Ghanem Island. CLAIM ONLY; possibly the 11/21 Khasab hulls (FALCON's). No neutral mine confirmation; GATE 2 not asserted | search summary | FALCON |
| 12 | Olym to Hao Fan, about 200,000 bbl ship-to-ship near Kharg, transponders off | X relay of Bloomberg, article not read | FALCON, BRENT |
| 13 | Disney Treasure turned back to Port Canaveral 11/22, reason unknown, second in two days per the poster | local scanner post | CRUISE |

**Already carried:** Merkury (006), Bahrain blasts (20261121-002), Nvidia SEC (20261121-001), Trump on Huang (001), Poland (009 updates it). **No action:** Schiff 'worse than 2008'.
